TATSUJIN/DissolveLaser.note: One cell of a horizontal _Divided sheet chosen by _StartIndex; _DisolveTex luminance < _Threshold discards; col = tex * vcolor * _TintColor * (2 - _Threshold).

TATSUJIN/EffectCommon.note: 2 * vcolor * _TintColor * _MainTex with material blend/ztest/cull; fog fades rgb to black.

TATSUJIN/NormalShot.note: Player shot: 2 * vcolor * _TintColor * _MainTex, alpha saturated, fog to black, optional soft-particle fade.

TATSUJIN/Particle/Additive.note: Additive particle: tex * vcolor, alpha clip at _ClipLevel, clip-space z += _shifter; fog only with _USEFOG_ON.

TATSUJIN/Particle/AlphaBlended.note: Alpha-blended particle: tex * vcolor with alpha clip at _ClipLevel; fog only with _USEFOG_ON.

TATSUJIN/Particle/Subtractive.note: Reverse-subtract particle: tex * vcolor; fog only with _USEFOG_ON.

TATSUJIN/SpriteAnime.note: Sprite-sheet cell _AIndex of _DividedH x _DividedV (vertex uv); 2 * vcolor * _TintColor * tex with material blend/blendop.

TATSUJIN/SpriteBillboard.note: View-space billboard at the object's position scaled by its axis lengths; tex with alpha * _TexAlpha.

TATSUJIN/SpriteBillbordAnime.note: View-space billboard rotating by _Time.y * _RotateSpeed * _Tx_SpeedRate, sprite-sheet cell _AIndex, 2 * vcolor * _TintColor * tex.

TATSUJIN/ThunderLaserAnime.note: Thunder laser: sprite-sheet cell _AIndex of _DividedH x _DividedV, 2 * vcolor * _TintColor * tex, material blend states.

KANAI/SpriteAdd.note: Sprites-Default program (premultiplied tex * colour) drawn with Blend One One.

UI/Trasition.note: Rule-texture UI transition: discard where _RuleTex.a < (1 - colour alpha) * 1.001; premultiplied output.

TXE/AE/Add.note: UI additive: (tex + _TextureSampleAdd) * colour with Blend SrcAlpha One.

TXE/AE/Default.note: UI normal: (tex + _TextureSampleAdd) * colour with alpha blend.

TXE/AE/HardLight.note: UI hard light in two passes (add (2c^2-c)a/D, then multiply by D).

TXE/AE/Mul.note: UI multiply: lerp(1, colour, alpha) with Blend DstColor Zero.

TXE/AE/Overlay.note: UI overlay in two passes (DstColor DstColor, then DstColor Zero).

TXE/AE/Screen.note: UI screen: premultiplied colour with Blend One OneMinusSrcColor.

TXE/AE/SoftLight.note: UI soft light in two passes (DstColor DstColor, then DstColor Zero).

TXE/AE/Sub.note: UI subtract-like: (tex + _TextureSampleAdd) * colour with Blend Zero OneMinusSrcColor.
